name: Roxy
summary: Roxy is one half of Real Dimez, the duo signed to Only Raw Records.
biographyHtml: Rockstar names Roxy as a member of Real Dimez alongside Bae-Luxe. The shared official group artwork shows the duo; it is not identified as a solo portrait.
imageCaption: Shared official Real Dimez group artwork; this is not an individual portrait.
